Cabinet / CabinetAI device capabilities V1 设备 日历 健康 审批: reported live 2026-10-27, reads system calendar, reminders and health data (activity, sleep, heart rate). Calendar/reminder changes are proposals and execute only after the user clicks Apply. One change has one button; multiple changes or any deletion require item selection; deletion items default unchecked. Cabinet / CabinetAI reliability 可靠性 幂等 重试 时区: product principles reflected in code/acceptance criteria: clarify ambiguous dates; never report unsupported success (no article body means not collected, disconnected calendar means not rescheduled, heard does not mean mastered). Preserve successful partial results and retry only failed parts; idempotent submissions and double approval execute once; invalidate stale approvals when underlying data changes. External actions require approval by default; V1 excludes payments/transfers/purchases. Reminder ordering uses account-local calendar date; four timezones and daylight-saving transitions were validated. Principles/acceptance criteria do not establish every workflow passed real-provider end-to-end tests.
